papers.title: Chow Obstructions and Prescribed Actual Green Pairs
papers.subtitle: Actual forms over the original valued field
papers.summary: A proof of the Chow-invariant actual Bott–Chern obstruction and prescribed curved Green pairs on the exact support complement, over the original finite extension of Q_p and against every compact actual test.
papers.evidence: Source-reviewed internal theorem. The complete proof includes the analytic comparison, model-Chern detector, scalar–curvature trace, supported complexes, global primitives and integral scope. This is not external peer review or a formal proof certificate.

papers.title: Local Curvature Obstructions and Beilinson–Bloch Height Pairings
papers.subtitle: Curvature correction, Chow correspondences and the global pairing
papers.summary: The proved actual Chow obstruction, geometric covariance and all-local-kernel height reduce full-domain existence to vanishing on localized global classes in both complementary degrees.
papers.status: Kernel construction proved; general vanishing open
papers.evidence: The three former analytic hypotheses and normalized comparison task have proofs on all local kernels and supplied admissible model domains. The general source-image vanishing and finite-test comparison problems remain open.

papers.title: Zero-Curvature Green Forms and Beilinson–Bloch Height Pairings
papers.subtitle: Local Green forms, principal divisors and descent to Chow groups
papers.summary: The direct construction from strong Green forms, with proved actual-test current calculus, normal-carrier residues, finite trace, projective integration and the product-formula descent.
papers.status: Proved implication from Strong Green; general existence open
papers.evidence: The four former analytic hypotheses and the supported-residue task have internal proofs on their stated domains. General Strong G remains the existence premise; broader functoriality and admissible-model existence are separate questions.

papers.title: Admissible Arithmetic Liftings and Beilinson–Bloch Height Pairings
papers.subtitle: Shou-Wu Zhang’s construction and the standard conjectures
papers.summary: Zhang’s construction through vertical corrections on arithmetic models, the role of the standard conjectures, and the unconditional case of a product of a curve and a surface.
papers.evidence: Published results are attributed to precise sources. The general standard-conjecture route and Hypothesis 5.1 for selected arithmetic-model projection operations remain conditional; the curve–surface case is distinguished from them.

papers.title: Strong Green Forms and Beilinson–Bloch Heights
papers.subtitle: A local-to-global research programme
papers.summary: The precise local conjecture, proved actual-form and height foundations, and remaining problems on homological source vanishing, finite-test identification, admissible models, positivity and integral finiteness.
papers.evidence: The Chow obstruction, finite actual trace and rational-fibre rigidity have internal proofs. The height on all local obstruction kernels is established; Hypothesis 5.2 retains the separate identification with a fixed finite-test kernel. General Strong G remains open.

papers.title: Arithmetic Conjectures for Beilinson–Bloch Heights
papers.subtitle: Central classes, positivity, and integral Northcott
papers.summary: A hierarchical conjectural package for products of curves, with the distinction between real positivity, integral discreteness, and varying fields made explicit.
papers.evidence: Open arithmetic targets and explicitly conditional implications. The height axioms are hypotheses, not consequences of publication.

papers.title: Local Green Forms and Chow Correspondences: Constructions and Geometric Transfer
papers.subtitle: Constructions and geometric transfer
papers.summary: Proofs of the actual obstruction, finite trace, rational-fibre rigidity, numerical descent and Chow covariance, with algebraic-equivalence and abelian-motivic applications in their stated geometric scope.
papers.evidence: Theorem 1.2 assembles the separately proved (A1), (A2), (R), (N) and (C) packages. Original-field normalization, prescribed support and all compact actual tests are retained. Further model certificates and general homological vanishing are not asserted.

papers.title: Arithmetic Lefschetz and Integral Heights
papers.subtitle: Proofs and reductions on products of curves
papers.summary: Complete arguments for the Chow-block decomposition, central reduction, primitive sum of squares, arithmetic regulators, lattice criteria, and class-field reduction.
papers.evidence: Full supplied internal arguments. Height-dependent statements assume the stated system H1–H4. “Internal proof” does not mean external peer review.

papers.title: Normalized Determinants and Height Metrics
papers.subtitle: Quillen isometry, Deligne pairing, and good reduction
papers.summary: An exact normalized projection-formula isometry and its rank-zero, curve-correspondence, and good-reduction consequences, with full proofs.
papers.evidence: The full supplied determinant comparison arguments are retained. Bad-reduction and general family comparisons remain separate research questions.

papers.title: Global Height Pairings from Admitted Green Classes
papers.subtitle: Assembly, reciprocity, adjunction, and model comparison
papers.summary: The proved normalized height on the intersection of all local obstruction kernels, the Strong Green implication for full Chow groups, correspondence adjunction, and comparison on supplied admissible models.
papers.status: Internal proofs; full-domain existence remains conditional
papers.evidence: Propositions 2.1–2.7 provide the stated analytic and geometric foundations. H16 uses the all-completion kernel; PH16 Theorem 7.5 still assumes Strong G in both complementary degrees. HA16 and MM16 retain their exact common-domain and supplied-model scope.

papers.title: Domains and Constructions of Beilinson–Bloch Height Pairings
papers.subtitle: Complete and partial cases, with their proof dependencies
papers.summary: The height on all local obstruction kernels and its geometric domains, with explicit endpoint, algebraic-equivalence and Chow-retraction deductions; additional model and finite-period conditions remain stated.
papers.status: Internal proofs with explicit geometric premises
papers.evidence: Propositions 2.2–2.3 prove numerical descent and Chow covariance. Theorem 2.4 proves the all-local-kernel height and its stated adjunction and supplied-model comparisons. Each application retains its geometric, model or period-comparison conditions.

publication.unpublishedLegacyArtifacts: Historical signed PDFs and source ZIPs have not been republished. Current papers and unsigned source copies are available in this edition. The original research archive is preserved separately.
publication.statusPolicy: Proved means an internal proof with the cited mathematical scope and exact source binding. The 22-item audit retains geometric premises, fixed-field normalization, exact support and all compact actual tests. Publication and automated checks are not external peer review or formal proof acceptance.

constructionReview.level: Internal AI source review with separate cross-reviews of the expanded analytic arguments and theorem assembly
constructionReview.scope: The exact Chow obstruction and prescribed curved Green pairs in Theorem 1.1, over the original finite K/Q_p, smooth integral projective X, exact support and all compact actual tests.
constructionReview.remaining: General homologically trivial source-image vanishing. This v0.5.2 review did not cover the broader analytic and height foundations, which are addressed separately by the v0.5.3 hypothesis audit.

change.kind: Source review, complete proofs and synchronized publication

hypothesisAudit.reviewType: Internal AI-assisted source review and cross-review; not external peer review or formal verification.

rows.label: hyp:height-calculus
rows.title: Actual forms, currents, and scalar Green functions
rows.scope: Actual pullback, product, support avoidance and Stokes; Green-current operations are defined on the algebraic dual of compact actual tests. This does not assert multiplication of an arbitrary classical distribution by a delta-form.
rows.clarification: The current operation is stated for actual-test Green functionals; a broader statement for arbitrary classical currents is not proved.

rows.label: hyp:height-supported
rows.title: Supported-complex Green construction
rows.scope: The finite-flat line presentation, full localized Chern polynomial and all-actual top-degree evaluation give the supported residue identity. Derived base change and proper projection are the stated bivariant identities.

rows.label: hyp:height-trace
rows.title: Finite trace and projective-bundle integration
rows.scope: FT16 constructs full finite actual trace on normal carriers. AD15, UG15 and FC16 construct projective-line output; OUT16 proves the additional target-factor identity and all-actual adjunction.

rows.label: hyp:height-immersion
rows.title: Immersion germs
rows.scope: Unit lifts through affinoid quotients and the smooth-stratum argument give actual germs along reduced pure-dimensional closed immersions, with degreewise extension on the stated ambient opens.

rows.label: hyp:height-covariance
rows.title: The obstruction and its covariance
rows.scope: Projective-bundle cohomology, smooth-center blowup injectivity, deformation to the normal cone and graph factorization prove proper Chow-kernel covariance and dominant detection.

rows.label: hyp:height-model
rows.title: Model forms and good reduction
rows.scope: The model-Chern detector, cap/Adams identification and smooth proper base change prove the model and good-reduction assertions. Admissible lifts on arbitrary bad-reduction models are not asserted.

rows.label: hyp:height-geometric
rows.title: Geometric domains used in the domain corollary
rows.scope: The enumerated endpoint, one-cycle, low-dimensional rational-domination, algebraic-equivalence, abelian and Chow-motivic cases retain their exact field, degree and geometric premises.

rows.label: hyp:construction-calculus
rows.title: Actual curvatures and geometric transfer
rows.scope: The separate proofs of (A1), (A2), (R), (N) and (C) are assembled with original-field normalization, exact support and all compact actual tests. General homological vanishing is not claimed.

rows.label: groute:current-calculus
rows.title: Actual forms and Green currents
rows.scope: The actual-test dual and support avoidance justify the disjoint-polar Green-current calculation; scalar Poincare–Lelong retains normal carriers and native divisor coefficients.
rows.clarification: The current operation is stated for actual-test Green functionals; a broader statement for arbitrary classical currents is not proved.

rows.label: groute:principal-operations
rows.title: Supported residues, extension and integration
rows.scope: Supported point residues, algebraic immersion germs and all-actual projective integration are proved on the precise carriers and proper-intersection domains used by principal push.

rows.label: groute:global-compatibility
rows.title: Moving, good reduction and infinite places
rows.scope: Higher-Chow moving, good-reduction spreading and the complex Green calculation give one global principal norm and a finite set of nonzero local terms for each fixed pair.

rows.label: groute:trace
rows.title: Finite trace and native weights
rows.scope: Full finite actual trace and the native change-of-ground-field formula retain both generic lengths and complete residue and field degrees.

rows.label: obroute:fibre-constancy
rows.title: Constancy on nearby rational fibres
rows.scope: Equality of unit valuations near a rational section, followed by properness of the compact fibre, proves literal constancy in the ordinary actual sheaf.

rows.label: obroute:covariance
rows.title: Preservation of the obstruction kernels
rows.scope: Projective integration and smooth-immersion deformation prove proper Chow-kernel stability. Pullback, the curvature ring identity and proper push then prove correspondence stability.

rows.label: obroute:height-identities
rows.title: Local height identities
rows.scope: Supported residues and actual-test Stokes give local reciprocity and choice independence; good models give finite support and higher-Chow moving gives the principal norm law.

rows.label: prop:numerical
rows.title: Finite numerical-model criterion
rows.scope: The vertical numerical detector kills curvature upstairs. Full finite trace of its global primitive, divided by the complete native degree, gives obstruction vanishing downstairs.

rows.label: prop:covariance
rows.title: Native Chow-kernel covariance
rows.scope: The all-actual projective operator, smooth-center deformation and graph factorization prove kernel covariance for rational Chow correspondences with their actual degree shifts.

rows.label: hyp:height-input
rows.title: Admitted-domain reciprocity and comparison
rows.scope: H16 constructs the pairing on both all-local-kernel factors. HA16 proves correspondence adjunction there; MM16 compares with supplied admissible models and classical abelian heights.

rows.label: hyp:trace
rows.title: A compatible finite trace
rows.scope: The graph kernel with independent torus parameters reconstructs finite trace in every bidegree on normal carriers, including all-actual adjunction and native degree normalization.

rows.label: hyp:rigidity
rows.title: Rational-fibre rigidity
rows.scope: The unit-presentation equality near a rational section and properness of the parameter projection supply one ordinary neighborhood for the complete fibre.

rows.label: hyp:assembly
rows.title: Height assembly on the kernel domain
rows.scope: The all-completion kernel pairing is proved separately. Identifying a fixed, cycle-independent finite-test kernel with that domain remains an additional comparison hypothesis in both complementary degrees.
rows.clarification: The proved all-local-kernel construction is separated from the still unproved finite-test identification; both domains are now named distinctly.

rows.label: hyp:zhang-model-projection
rows.title: Projection formula on the models used
rows.scope: Arithmetic pullback, pushforward, projection and generic-degree identities must exist for the selected model morphisms. Equality of numerical heights does not construct those operations on arbitrary nonflat models.

hypothesisAudit.scopeNote: Each status refers to the precise revised statement and its supplied proof. The actual-test functional convention is made explicit, and the proved all-local-kernel construction is separated from finite-test identification. General Strong G, general homological obstruction vanishing, positivity and arithmetic finiteness remain open.
